camel_example: aliyun elasticsearch GET /openapi/collectors --region cn-hangzhou --instanceId 'es-cn-nif1q8auz00030000' --size 10 --sourceType ECS --name collectorName1 --page 1 --resId 'ct-cn-77uqof2s7rg5c0000' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-collectors --res-id ct-cn-77uqof2s7rg5c0000 --name collectorName1 --instance-id es-cn-nif1q8auz00030000 --page 1 --size 10 --source-type ECS --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCollectors

parameters.help_en: The instance ID associated with the collector
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the returned results. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的分页数。默认值：1，最小值：1，最大值：200
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of results per page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页的结果数。默认值：20，最小值：1，最大值：500
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en:
The type of machine on which the collector is deployed. If this parameter is not specified, all types are returned. Valid values:

ECS: ECS instance

ACK: Container Kubernetes cluster
parameters.help_zh:
指定采集器部署机器的类型，不填返回全部类型。可选值：

ECS：ECS实例

ACK：容器Kubernetes集群
parameters.name: source_type

X-Total-Count.description_en: The total number of returned records

configs.description_en: The configuration file information of the collector
configs.description_zh: 采集器的配置文件信息

content.example:
- key: log
 title: Log file content
 description: >
 Contains log file lines.
 ....

dryRun.description_en:
Indicates whether the collector is validated and created. Valid values:

true: Only validated, not created.
false: Validated and created
dryRun.description_zh:
是否校验并创建采集器。支持：

true：只校验不创建
false：校验并创建

configType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:

collectorTargetInstance: the collector Output
collectorDeployMachine: the deployment machine of the collector
collectorElasticsearchForKibana: the Elasticsearch instance that supports Kibana dashboards
configType.description_zh:
配置类型。支持：

collectorTargetInstance：采集器Output
collectorDeployMachine：采集器的部署机器
collectorElasticsearchForKibana：支持Kibana仪表盘的Elasticsearch实例信息

enableMonitoring.description_en:
Indicates whether Monitoring is enabled. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorTargetInstance and instanceType is elasticsearch. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Not enabled
enableMonitoring.description_zh:
是否启用Monitoring，当configType为collectorTargetInstance，且instanceType为elasticsearch时显示。支持：

true：启用

false：不启用

groupId.description_en: The machine group ID. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorDeployMachine

host.description_en: The internal-facing access address of Kibana over the private network after Kibana Dashboard is enabled. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorElasticsearchForKibana
host.description_zh: 启用Kibana Dashboard后，Kibana的私网访问地址。当configType为collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

items.description_en: The list of access addresses for the instance specified in the collector Output. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorTargetInstance
items.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问地址列表。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

instanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance associated with the collector. When configType is collectorTargetInstance, this is the instance ID of the collector Output. When configType is collectorDeployMachines and type is ACKCluster, this is the ACK (Container Kubernetes) cluster ID
instanceId.description_zh: 采集器关联的实例ID。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时，为采集器Output的实例ID；当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时，为ACK（容器Kubernetes）集群ID

instanceType.description_en: The type of instance specified in the collector Output. Supported values: elasticsearch, logstash. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorTargetInstance
instanceType.description_zh: 采集器Output指定的实例类型。支持elasticsearch、logstash。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

kibanaHost.description_en: The public network access address of Kibana after Kibana Dashboard is enabled. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorElasticsearchForKibana
kibanaHost.description_zh: 启用Kibana Dashboard后，Kibana的公网访问地址。当configType为collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

machines.description_en: The list of ECS machines on which the collector is deployed. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorDeployMachines and type is ECSInstanceId
machines.description_zh: 采集器所部署的ECS机器列表信息。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ECSInstanceId时显示

agentStatus.description_en:
The status of the collector on the ECS instance. Valid values:

heartOk: Normal heartbeat.
heartLost: Abnormal heartbeat.
uninstalled: Not installed.
failed: Installation failed
agentStatus.description_zh:
ECS上各采集器的状态。支持：

heartOk：心跳正常
heartLost：心跳异常
uninstalled：未安装
failed：安装失败

protocol.description_en: The transmission protocol, which must be consistent with the access protocol of the instance specified in the collector Output. Supported values: HTTP, HTTPS. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorTargetInstance
protocol.description_zh: 传输协议，需要与采集器Output指定实例的访问协议保持一致。支持HTTP、HTTPS。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

successPodsCount.description_en: The number of Pod nodes successfully collected in the ACK cluster. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorDeployMachines and type is ACKCluster
successPodsCount.description_zh: ACK集群所有成功采集的Pod节点数。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时显示

totalPodsCount.description_en: The total number of Pod nodes collected in the ACK cluster. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorDeployMachines and type is ACKCluster
totalPodsCount.description_zh: ACK集群所有采集的Pod节点数。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时显示

type.description_en:
The type of machine on which the collector is deployed. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorDeployMachine. Valid values:

ECSInstanceId: ECS

ACKCluster: Container Kubernetes
type.description_zh:
采集器部署的机器类型，当configType为collectorDeployMachine时显示。支持：

ECSInstanceId：ECS

ACKCluster：容器Kubernetes

userName.description_en: The username used to access the instance specified in the collector Output. Default value: elastic. This parameter is displayed when configType is collectorTargetInstance or collectorElasticsearchForKibana
userName.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问用户名，默认为elastic。当configType为collectorTargetInstance或collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

gmtCreatedTime.description_en: The time when the collector was created

gmtUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the collector was last updated

resType.description_en: The collector type. Supported values: fileBeat, metricBeat, heartBeat, and auditBeat

status.description_en:
The collector status. Valid values:

activing: Taking effect.

active: Active
status.description_zh:
采集器状态。支持：

activing：生效中

active：已生效

vpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC where the collector resides
vpcId.description_zh: 采集器所在的专有网络ID
